scope: 用户否决旧整批五星六星，原因是雷同；旧素材和交付包仅历史保留。关羽一至四星认可冻结。当前仅五星驾驶巨型青龙人形机甲关羽一张候选待审，早先非人形机械长龙被后续要求覆盖。
material_requirement: Smooth precision armor, large complete surfaces, clear bevels and concentrated highlights; no dense gold dust, pitted rust or heavy weathering.
composition: Guan Yu visible in chest cockpit of giant dragon-themed humanoid mecha, holding a long Green Dragon crescent blade with both hands; ancient city establishes scale.
